output_list.vulnerability: Exploitable: Token Holder Can Freeze Their Own Tokens
output_list.criticism: This token allows any address to freeze its own tokens, which makes them bypass the anti-airdrop system. This allows token holders to bypass the anti-airdrop system and receive tokens from the airdrop. This is a vulnerability that makes the token value unpredictable and unmanageable. This vulnerability is very profitable and high severity, and requires correct mitigation.
